name: varlock
description_en: AI-safe .env files: Schemas for agents, Secrets for humans.
readme_excerpt: Varlock > AI-safe .env files: Schemas for agents, Secrets for humans. - 🤖 AI-safe config — agents read your schema, never your secrets - 🔍 proactive leak scanning via varlock scan + git hooks - 🔏 runtime protection — log redaction and leak prevention - 🛡️ validation, coercion, type safety w/ IntelliSense - 🌐 flexible multi-environment management — auto .env. loading and explicit import - 🔌 plugins to pull data from various backends (1Password, Infisical, AWS, Azure, GCP, HCP Vault, more!)…
